description: TOML to JSON converter — Offline TOML 1.0 parser: text= or url= (Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml, config files; GitHub blob links work) returns JSON with stats, or exact error with line number (duplicate keys, redefined tables, bad strings/numbers). Supports dotted keys, inline tables, arrays of tables, multi-line strings, hex/octal/binary, inf/nan; dates come back as ISO strings. Reverse: json= (a JSON object) returns TOML. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_toml_json
